no_bandwidth_scaling.description: Force all bands to FR1 bandwidth 0.1 GHz
no_bandwidth_scaling.note: Without bandwidth scaling, FR3 loses close-target advantage — negative for naive carrier-only claim

fixed_n_ant_8.description: Hold N=8 across bands (disable aperture growth)
fixed_n_ant_8.note: Angular improvement disappears — aperture growth is the FR3/mmWave angle driver
